definitions: A season of the year between winter and summer, lasting from March to May in the northern hemisphere and from September to November in the southern hemisphere.
A coiled metal wire that returns to its original shape when compressed or extended, used to store energy or absorb shock.
A place where water naturally flows out from the ground.
A sudden jump or rapid movement upwards or forwards.
examples: The flowers bloom in the spring.
We drank from the mountain spring.
He made a spring for the ball.
